title: Shasqi presented 2 posters at the 15th World ADC San Diego Conference
body_markdown: Shasqi presented two posters at the 15th World ADC San Diego Conference on November 4, 2024 in San Diego, California. The posters were titled, *CEACAM5 is an Ideal Target for Click Chemistry Enabled Pre-Targeting* and *Pre-Targeting with In Vivo Click Chemistry Enables Preferential Drug Exposure in Tumors versus Normal Tissues* .
